<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE test [
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://127.0.0.1/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext;
]>
<root xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <xi:include href="nonexistent.xml" parse="xml">
    <xi:fallback>
      <fallback-node>Content</fallback-node>
    </xi:fallback>
  </xi:include>
</root>
```

<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.org/ns2">
  <ns2:element ns2:attr="val" attr-default="true">
    <?target processing instruction data?>
    <!-- XML comment with -- invalid sequence handled -->
  </ns2:element>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % intEnt "<!ELEMENT internal (#PCDATA)>">
  %intEnt;
]>
<root>
  <item>ABC</item>
  <internal>Entity test</internal>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns">
  <ns:node id="1">
    <ns:child>Text node content</ns:child>
    <ns:empty/>
  </ns:node>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ATTLIST book id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
]>
<catalog>
  <book id="b1">
    <title>XML Parsing Techniques</title>
    <author>Expert Fuzzer</author>
  </book>
</catalog>
